data.description:
The second page came up from the deep hold, rotted half through. What's left of the brush points down, to the rooms the Core spoiled.

This weekend's challenges
1. Win The Captain's Watch once. Reward: an Archive Chart Case.
2. Win the Low Tide Run or the Night Watch once. Reward: a Medicine Inro.
3. Win The Fall once. Reward: Galley Stores.
4. Win The Rotted Reliquary once. Its seal comes from steeping a Reliquary Seal with 3 Core Rot. Reward: a Skyglass Coffer.
5. Win The Burning Heading once. The Rotted Heading comes from steeping The Last Heading with 3 Core Rot. Reward: a Sealed Treasury.
All five: a Skyglass Token.

Rules
Only wins after you take this page count. Do them in any order, and claim each reward from its card in the Logbook. The page closes at the end of Monday (00:00 UTC Tuesday).
